name: rust-cli
description: Create a small Rust CLI with a library function, CLI wiring and tests.
prompt:
You are in a small Rust crate. Implement it in place:

- `src/lib.rs`: expose `pub fn greeting(name: &str) -> String` that returns exactly `Hello, <name>!`.
- `src/main.rs`: print the greeting for the first command-line argument, defaulting to `world` when no argument is given.
- Add at least one unit or integration test (`#[test]`) that covers the greeting.
- Keep the existing crate name and do not add external dependencies.
- Before finishing, run `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` and fix any failure.

Work only in the current directory. Do not commit, do not ask questions, and do not stop before the checks pass.

checks.name: tests present
args: const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');let n=0;function walk(d){if(!fs.existsSync(d))return;for(const e of fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true})){const p=path.join(d,e.name);if(e.isDirectory())walk(p);else if(e.name.endsWith('.rs')&&/\[test\]/.test(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')))n++}}walk('src');walk('tests');if(n===0){console.error('no #[test] found in src/ or tests/');process.exit(1)}console.log(n+' test(s) found')

checks.name: CLI output
args: const {execFileSync}=require('child_process');function run(args){try{return execFileSync('cargo',['run','--quiet','--',...args],{encoding:'utf8',stdio:['ignore','pipe','pipe']}).trim()}catch(e){console.error(String(e.stderr||e.message));process.exit(1)}}const named=run(['Ada']);if(named!=='Hello, Ada!'){console.error('with argument: expected Hello, Ada!, got '+JSON.stringify(named));process.exit(1)}const dflt=run([]);if(dflt!=='Hello, world!'){console.error('without argument: expected Hello, world!, got '+JSON.stringify(dflt));process.exit(1)}console.log('CLI output OK')
